description: Verified reference data for AI agents. Every figure carries an official source URL and a verifiedDate — built for the questions agents misquote from memory. No auth, CORS-open. Country-prefixed: /api/uk/*; more countries later.

GET /.well-known/changes.json.description: Protocol discovery document: areas tracked, cadence, endpoints (json/html/rss/atom/mcp), schema URL, licence, contact.

GET /.well-known/facts.json.description: Verified Facts discovery document: namespaces, endpoints, key examples, conformance level, keys (JWKS), OpenAPI and MCP.

GET /api/calendar.description: Calendar facts for 2026–2028, verified 2026-10-04: kind=holidays — public holidays by region for uk, us, de, fr from gov.uk, OPM, the German Länder and calendrier.api.gouv.fr; kind=tax-year — start/end and periods for uk, us, au, in, ca, de, fr, br, pl with the statute quoted; kind=dst — daylight-saving rule and switch dates for uk, de, fr, us, au, br. Empty query lists coverage; unknown country/region/year answers covered:false with nearest.

params.country: one of uk, us, de, fr, au, in, ca, br, pl or a name
params.region: UK nation, German Land, metropole | alsace-moselle (optional)

GET /api/calendar/next.description: The next public holiday strictly after a date (default today) for uk, us, de, fr, with the three that follow; same snapshot as /api/calendar.

params.country: one of uk, us, de, fr

GET /api/changes.description: What changed in the verified datasets since a date (REST mirror of what_changed_since). format=html|rss|atom serves the /changes page or feeds instead of JSON.

params.area: uk-rates | uk-exams | vehicles | software-eol | policy-rates | us-rates | de-rates | uk-vehicle-rules | uk-exam-dates | calendar | uk-gov-process | jp-vehicle-costs | jp-living-costs | all

GET /api/de/rates.description: German tax and social-insurance figures for Veranlagungszeitraum 2026, verified 2026-10-03 against the consolidated statutes, the Bundesgesetzblatt and the BMG/DRV/BMAS pages: Grundfreibetrag and § 32a tariff zones, Solidaritätszuschlag, Beitragsbemessungsgrenzen, Bezugsgröße, Beitragssätze with employee/employer shares, Zusatzbeitrag, Mindestlohn (2026 and fixed 2027), Geringfügigkeitsgrenze, Kindergeld, Kinderfreibetrag, Pauschbeträge, Entfernungspauschale — each figure with German term, English label, source, quote, verifiedDate and prior value. Committed data (not a live proxy), refreshed annually when the next year's Verordnung is final.

params.category: one of income-tax, social-insurance, minimum-wage, minijob, kindergeld, kinderfreibetrag, sparer-pauschbetrag, arbeitnehmer-pauschbetrag, entfernungspauschale (omit to list)

GET /api/jp/living-costs.description: Japan daily-life official figures, verified 2026-10-24 against the official pages: 地域別最低賃金 FY2026 by prefecture (with each 発効日 and the FY2025 amount), 協会けんぽ health insurance rates by prefecture, 介護 and 子ども・子育て支援金 rates, 厚生年金 / 国民年金, 雇用保険料率, 児童手当, 出産育児一時金, 高額療養費, 2027 national holidays, 消費税, 基礎控除 / 給与所得控除 and 住民税 均等割 — each figure with the Japanese term, quoted row, source URL and effectiveFrom.

params.category: one of minimum-wage, health-insurance, pension, employment-insurance, benefits, holidays, consumption-tax, income-tax, resident-tax (omit to list)

GET /api/jp/vehicle-costs.description: Japan vehicle statutory costs, verified 2026-10-24 against the official pages: 自動車重量税 at 車検 (2026-05-01 – 2028-04-30 table), エコカー減税 bands, 自賠責保険 for private passenger and kei cars (before and from 2026-11-01), 継続検査 fees from 2026-04-01, 自動車税 by displacement and 軽自動車税 — each figure with the Japanese term, quoted row, source URL and effectiveFrom.

params.category: one of weight-tax, weight-tax-eco, cali, inspection-fee, auto-tax, kei-tax (omit to list)

GET /api/policy-rates.description: Central-bank policy rates, verified 2026-10-03 against the banks' own pages: Bank of England Bank Rate, US Federal Reserve federal funds target range (lower/upper bound), ECB deposit facility, main refinancing and marginal lending rates — each with effectiveFrom, decisionDate and meeting, previous level, latest decision, next scheduled decision and the decision press release. Committed data (not a live proxy), re-verified within 45 days and after each decision.

GET /api/provenance/domain.description: Who runs this domain? Live RDAP: age, registrar, nameservers, typosquat resemblance. Descriptive signals, not a verdict.

GET /api/provenance/package.description: Who publishes this package, and is it a typosquat? Live npm/PyPI metadata.

GET /api/software-eol/status.description: Is this version still supported, and until when? nodejs, python, ubuntu, debian, android, ios, macos, windows, oracle-jdk, go, ruby, php, postgresql, react — a monthly snapshot of endoflife.date open data (MIT; 340 release cycles, verified 2026-10-03). A version resolves to its release cycle ("18.19.0" → 18, "3.11.4" → 3.11, "22.04.3" → 22.04, "bookworm" → 12); returns supported true|false as of today, eol date, days remaining or since, active/extended-support ends, LTS, latest release, the newest supported cycle, a plain-statement recommendation and the endoflife.date page as source.

params.product: one of nodejs, python, ubuntu, debian, android, ios, macos, windows, oracle-jdk, go, ruby, php, postgresql, react (aliases: node, java, jdk, postgres, golang, osx, win)

GET /api/software-eol/timeline.description: Every release cycle of a product, newest first, with release date, supported true|false, eol, LTS, latest release and support-end dates; same snapshot as /status.

params.product: one of nodejs, python, ubuntu, debian, android, ios, macos, windows, oracle-jdk, go, ruby, php, postgresql, react

GET /api/tax/take-home.description: Take-home pay after income tax and social contributions for uk, us, ca, au, in, br, pl, fr, de, es: gross, net and total deductions (annual + monthly), typed breakdown, effectiveRate, taxYear, currency, assumptions. Live proxy to the LifeByNumbers salary calculators (same operator). Spain (es) returns covered:false — no backend calculator.

params.country: uk | us | ca | au | in | br | pl | fr | de | es
params.gross: salary in local currency (annual unless period=monthly)

GET /api/uk/exam-dates.description: UK exam dates verified 2026-10-04 against JCQ and the boards' own documents: results days, the summer 2027 exam timetable (JCQ window and the dates of GCSE Maths, English Language, Combined Science and A-level Maths papers at AQA, Pearson Edexcel, Cambridge OCR and WJEC/Eduqas, all final), entry deadlines with each board's late-fee dates, Scotland's results day and announced specification changes; each figure with source document, quoted row and the summer-2026 date as previous.

params.board: optional: jcq, aqa, pearson, ocr, wjec-eduqas, sqa, ofqual, dfe
params.kind: one of results, timetable, deadlines, spec-changes (omit to list)

GET /api/uk/exams/papers.description: Past-paper index: official assessment-resources links per spec (links only — papers are board copyright).

GET /api/uk/exams/specs.description: Spec metadata: codes, paper structure, durations, tiers, official links.

GET /api/uk/exams/topic.description: Which paper is a topic on? Built for queries like "is electricity paper 2 AQA".

GET /api/uk/gov-process.description: UK government service facts verified 2026-10-04 against gov.uk: fees, processing times as stated, eligibility and required documents (each with the quoted sentence and source URL), the official start URL and dated changes since 2025.

params.service: one of passport-renewal-adult, passport-child, driving-licence-renewal, provisional-licence, change-address, vehicle-tax-sorn, register-to-vote, register-birth, register-death, blue-badge, self-assessment, national-insurance-number, universal-credit, eu-settlement-scheme, evisa, eta, or an alias (passport, child-passport, brp, sorn, uc, euss, …); omit to list

GET /api/uk/rates.description: UK tax-year rates & thresholds (2026-27), verified against gov.uk.

params.category: one of income-tax, national-insurance, minimum-wage, student-loans, vat, isa, state-pension, state-pension-age, stamp-duty, capital-gains, pensions, dividends, savings, marriage-allowance, statutory-sick-pay, statutory-parental-pay, child-benefit (omit to list)

GET /api/uk/vehicle-rules.description: UK vehicle tax (VED) and MOT rules for 2026-27, verified 2026-10-04 against gov.uk: first-year VED by CO2 band (cars registered on or after 1 April 2017), the standard rate and Direct Debit surcharges, the expensive car supplement (£40,000 / £50,000 zero-emission threshold, annual amount, years), bands A–M for 2001–2017 cars, pre-2001 engine-size rates, electric-car rules since 1 April 2025, historic-vehicle exemptions, MOT due dates, maximum fees, early renewal, retests, exemptions and penalties — each figure with the quoted gov.uk line, source URL, effectiveFrom and its previous-year value.

params.category: one of ved-first-year, ved-standard, ved-expensive-car, ved-2001-2017, ved-pre-2001, ved-electric, historic, mot, penalties (omit to list)

GET /api/us/rates.description: US federal rates and thresholds for tax year 2026, verified 2026-10-03 against the IRS revenue procedures and notices and SSA's Federal Register notice: income-tax rate schedules (bracket rows) and standard deduction, Social Security wage base and rates, Medicare and Additional Medicare Tax, retirement-plan and IRA limits, HSA/HDHP limits, estate and gift exclusions — each figure with source, quote, verifiedDate and the prior-year value. Committed data (not a live proxy), refreshed annually at the IRS release window.

params.category: one of income-tax, social-security, medicare, retirement, hsa, estate-gift (omit to list)

endpoints.GET /api/vehicles/eu/safety-gate: STUB — EU Safety Gate vehicle alerts are being added; returns covered:false with the official URL for now.

GET /api/vehicles/fr/recalls.description: Official French vehicle recalls (RappelConso / DGCCRF open data, 1663 automobile fiches 2018-01-19 → 2026-08-07) for a brand (+ model): fiche number, date, risks, defect text, official fiche link.

GET /api/vehicles/fr/search.description: Keyword search across all RappelConso automobile fiches (French text), newest first, optional since date.

GET /api/vehicles/jp/complaints.description: MLIT owner defect reports (40870 across 264 models): total per model + breakdown by defective device.

GET /api/vehicles/jp/recalls.description: Official Japanese recall filings (国土交通省 MLIT; 2826 filings across 264 models sold in Japan, incl. Lexus and imports): notification number, date, device, affected vehicles, situation/remedy, official PDF. English or Japanese names.

GET /api/vehicles/uk/mot.description: Real UK MOT failure data for one model generation: per-category failure rates (overall and at your mileage), riskiest components. Live proxy to whatbreaks.uk (same operator; DfT anonymised MOT results).

GET /api/vehicles/uk/recalls.description: Official UK vehicle safety recalls (DVSA open data, OGL v3.0; 4876 recalls launched 2016-01-01 → 2027-02-03) for a make (+ model): recall number, launch date, concern, defect and remedy text, build-date range, vehicles affected, GOV.UK recall-checker link.

params.model: optional, e.g. Corsa (omit to list the make and its model names)

GET /api/vehicles/uk/recalls-search.description: Keyword search across all served DVSA recalls (English text: make, model, concern, defect, remedy), newest first, optional since date.

GET /api/vehicles/uk/search.description: Search the 530 UK model generations covered by the MOT dataset (live proxy to whatbreaks.uk).

GET /changes.description: The changelog as a page: every verified change to UK tax/NI thresholds, exam specs, official vehicle datasets, software end-of-life dates, central-bank policy rates, US federal tax thresholds, German tax and social-insurance thresholds, UK car tax (VED) and MOT rules, UK exam dates, public holidays, tax-year and daylight-saving dates, UK government service steps, fees and processing times, Japanese car inspection (車検) statutory costs and car taxes and Japanese minimum wages, social-insurance rates, pensions, benefits, holidays and tax thresholds, newest first by month — area, from → to, effectiveFrom, official source, maintainer note, verifiedDate. Indexable, cached 1 h at the edge.

params.area: optional: uk-rates | uk-exams | vehicles | software-eol | policy-rates | us-rates | de-rates | uk-vehicle-rules | uk-exam-dates | calendar | uk-gov-process | jp-vehicle-costs | jp-living-costs

GET /changes.atom.description: Atom feed of the changelog (?area= optional); same entries as /changes.rss.

GET /changes.rss.description: RSS 2.0 feed of the changelog (?area= optional). guid = permalink on /changes, link = official source, pubDate = verifiedDate.

GET /f.description: The fact index: every key with label, unit, period, verifiedDate and hash (?namespace=uk|us|de|eu; ?format=html for the page with schema.org Dataset). ?keys=k1,k2 (or POST /f {"keys": [...]}) is a batch of up to 50.

GET /f/resolve.description: Ranked canonical fact keys for a question or a guessed key, with the full record of an unambiguous top match.

GET /f/{key}.description: Verified Facts (verified-facts/0.2): one official figure by key — value, unit, period, effectiveFrom, official source, quote, verifiedDate, status against ?max_age=, a SHA-256 claim hash and an Ed25519 signature. Keys are <country>/<topic>/<fact>; a loose key resolves when unambiguous, otherwise 404 with candidates. ?format=txt (one line) | html (indexable page) | json; ?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD or ?period=2025-26 for a prior value held.

GET /openapi.json.description: OpenAPI 3.1 for the facts and changes endpoints (getFact, getFacts, resolveFact, whatChangedSince) — for LangChain / LlamaIndex OpenAPI tool loaders.

GET /protocol.description: The Verified Changes protocol v0.1 specification — the open convention /api/changes, /changes, the feeds and what_changed_since follow, so any site can publish dated, sourced from/to entries and any assistant can consume them. Indexable HTML; ?format=md returns the markdown.

GET /protocol/facts.description: The Verified Facts protocol v0.2 specification (indexable HTML; ?format=md returns the markdown).

GET /r/<route>?….description: Citation permalinks (human-readable answer + official source + verified date). Every API/MCP result includes one as cite.url.

GET /schema/changes.v0.json.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for a changes document and a single entry; /schema/well-known-changes.v0.json covers the discovery document.

GET|POST /api/stats.description: Exact statistics & probability — for the maths agents get wrong in their head. ?op= one of: descriptive, distribution, hypothesis-test, confidence-interval, bayes-update, regression. Array/table inputs via POST JSON body. Numerical core validated against reference tables.

POST /api/mcp.description: THE FRONT DOOR — one remote MCP server for the whole estate. Lists uk_rates_lookup, exam_topic_paper, domain_provenance, package_provenance, take_home_pay directly, plus what_changed_since (changes since your training cutoff), coverage, catalogue and call (run any tool by name). Every result carries freshness + a cite.url permalink.
POST /api/mcp.example: add https://databutler.dev/api/mcp to any MCP client

endpoints.POST /api/mcp/uk-exams: Remote MCP server — tools exam_topic_paper, exam_spec_lookup, exam_paper_index.
endpoints.POST /api/mcp/uk-gov-process: Remote MCP server — tool uk_gov_process {service}: UK government service fees, steps, processing times and dated changes, verified against gov.uk.

endpoints.POST /api/mcp/vehicles: Remote MCP server — uk_mot_reliability, uk_mot_vehicle_search (live via whatbreaks.uk), uk_recalls_for_model, uk_recalls_search (DVSA), fr_recalls_for_model, fr_recalls_search, jp_recalls_for_model, jp_complaints_summary, eu_safety_gate_recalls (stub).

name: Data Butler
note: Verified reference data for AI agents (UK, US and German rates, exam specs, provenance, statistics, vehicles, software support, policy rates). Every figure carries source + verifiedDate.
